en: A black-and-white or sepia-toned vintage postcard featuring a panoramic view of a river flowing through a town, with leafless trees in the foreground. Prominently on a hill in the distance is a large historical building, likely a castle or palace, with spires rising above. A church with a tall steeple is visible near the riverbank. The image captures the old European townscape from an elevated perspective. At the top left, there is red text in German.
